name: image-tools
description: Image Tools CLI surface. Single source of truth for the jobs and models domains: schema-validated against cli-manifest/v1 and cross-validated against the JobsService / ModelsService proto descriptors at test time. Loaded by cli/main.go via cliapp.LoadFromManifest.

groups.name: jobs
groups.description: Inspect and control durable async jobs

commands.name: get
commands.description: Get a durable job by id

commands.name: wait
commands.description: Block once until a job is terminal, then print it (no polling)

flags.name: limit
flags.description: Maximum jobs to return (0 = server default)

commands.name: cancel
commands.description: Cancel a running or queued job

groups.name: models
groups.description: Inspect the model registry and toggle models

commands.name: list
commands.description: List model registry entries (--operation OP to filter)

flags.name: operation
flags.description: Filter to models serving this operation

commands.name: get
commands.description: Get a model registry entry by id

commands.name: select
commands.description: Preview which model would run for an operation on this host (--override ID)

positionals.name: operation
positionals.description: Operation to select a model for

commands.name: enable
commands.description: Enable or disable a model (--disable to turn off); persisted overlay over the seed catalog

flags.name: disable
flags.description: Disable the model instead of enabling it

commands.name: blocklist
commands.description: List license-encumbered models excluded from the catalog

commands.name: install
commands.description: Install (download) a model's weights as a durable job (--wait to block once on completion)

flags.name: wait
flags.description: Block once until the download job is terminal (no polling)

commands.name: remove
commands.description: Remove a model's downloaded weights and clear its install record

commands.name: add-custom
commands.description: Register a custom/local model (repeat --operation per served op; --local-path or --download-url for weights)

positionals.name: id
positionals.description: Model id (must not collide with a seed model)

flags.name: operation
flags.description: An operation this model serves (repeat for several)

flags.name: local-path
flags.description: Absolute path to local weights (installed by reference; no download)

flags.name: download-url
flags.description: Remote download URL (used when --local-path is empty)

groups.name: ops
groups.description: Run deterministic image operations (resize, crop, convert, …)

commands.name: list
commands.description: List deterministic operations and supported formats

groups.name: ai
groups.description: Run model-backed AI generation & enhancement operations (async jobs)

groups.name: analyze
groups.description: Run image→data analysis operations (ocr, nsfw, probe)

groups.name: settings
groups.description: Inspect and pin per-operation default models

commands.name: list
commands.description: List the effective default model per operation (seed vs operator override)

commands.name: set-default
commands.description: Pin the default model for an operation

positionals.name: operation
positionals.description: Operation to pin a default for

omitted.reason: Server-streaming progress RPC. Exposed via the hand-appended `jobs watch` command (register.go) because cli-manifest/v1 bindings model unary connect-rpc calls only.

AI op submission rides the REST multipart edge (POST /api/v1/ai/{operation}); image/mask bytes can't ride a Connect call, so the per-op submit commands (generate, img2img, …) are hand-appended in cli/domains/ai/register.go.

Analysis execution rides the REST multipart edge (POST /api/v1/analysis/{operation}); image bytes can't ride a Connect call, so the per-op commands (probe, ocr, nsfw) are hand-appended in cli/domains/analyze/register.go.
